## Activity

River Outreach recorded 69 captures during November 2023. Activity proceeded as planned, with session lists managed in the usual way apart from routine leave. The recorded activity provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the month. No further activity information is included in this report.

## Image quality

Of the 69 captures, 4 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 5.8. The ungradable images could not be included in the grading assessment. The result is reported separately from the grading outcome to distinguish image-quality limitations from findings identified through grading. This provides a clear account of the proportion of captures that did not produce a gradable image.

## Grading

Grading identified 10 referable results from the captures assessed. The median lag from capture to grading was 0. This indicates that the midpoint of the recorded grading interval was 0. The grading result is presented alongside the image-quality information so that the monthly activity, ungradable captures, and referable results can be considered together.
